title: Acquisition Function-Guided Generation for Bayesian Optimization over Discrete Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.22763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) over discrete spaces is challenging due to missing gradients and the sparsity of valid solutions. Latent-space BO sidesteps both issues by fitting a surrogate in the latent space of a generative model, which however substantially complicates the direct incorporation of domain knowledge that is naturally expressed in the original discrete space. In this work, we instead combine a pretrained generative model with a surrogate defined directly in data space, where inductive biases such as domain-specific kernels can be readily incorporated. Rather than maximizing the acquisition function over the discrete design space, our method samples candidates from the generative model under a distribution tilted by the acquisition function. translated_title: 面向离散空间贝叶斯优化的采集函数引导生成方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.22763v1 公告类型：new 摘要：离散空间上的贝叶斯优化（BO）由于梯度缺失和有效解的稀疏性而充满挑战。潜在空间BO通过在生成模型的潜在空间中拟合代理模型来规避这两个问题，但这使得原本在原始离散空间中自然表达的领域知识难以直接融入。在这项工作中，我们转而将预训练的生成模型与直接在数据空间中定义的代理模型相结合，从而可以方便地引入领域特定核函数等归纳偏置。我们的方法不是在离散设计空间上最大化采集函数，而是让生成模型在一个由采集函数倾斜的分布下采样候选解。为了恢复用于采样的有用梯度，我们将该倾斜分布嵌入到一个扩散桥中，由此得到平滑的、后验平均化的采集函数。这引出了采集函数引导的生成……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该方法将预训练生成模型与数据空间代理模型相结合，通过扩散桥将采集函数倾斜分布转化为平滑的后验平均采集函数，从而引导生成模型采样候选解，实现便于融入领域知识的离散空间贝叶斯优化。
en_tdlr: This paper combines a pretrained generative model with a data-space surrogate, embedding the acquisition-tilted distribution into a diffusion bridge to yield a smooth, posterior-averaged acquisition function, thereby guiding candidate generation for Bayesian optimization over discrete spaces while readily incorporating domain knowledge.
